pages.text: Finds a text inside another text.$(br2)The result is the position of the first match, or -1 if there is none.

$(li)$(1)text$() STRING: the text to search in$(li)$(1)search$() STRING: the text to find$(li)$(1)start$() INTEGER: where the search begins (optional, default 0)$(li)result $(1)result$() INTEGER: the position, or -1
$(1)CALL c0de/strings/INSTR$(br)  PARAMETER text message ;$(br)  PARAMETER search "diamond" ;$(br)  RESULT result position$()
